_comment: Setup + controller configuration reference for this capture, added retrospectively (2026-06-26) to match the existing log-analysis setup.json convention. Captured by tools/telemetry/udp_telem_sniff.py --raw-bin (VREC). Decoders: tools/telemetry/{analyze_pitch_osc,pitch_verify,pitch_lag}.py.
capture_type: Clean 60 s INDI (k=20) capture; reached hover (throttle 0.67). Also holds the roll u-injection sysid chirp (fit_roll.csv) and its fit (indi_params.json).

hardware.airframe: X-quad. M1,M3 CW / M2,M4 CCW. IMU aligned. A motor was burned earlier in the 2026-06-25 session; pitch axis suspected physically asymmetric.

motor_geometry._comment: Inverted spin vs firmware default (flips s_mix_yaw only). Roll/pitch mix unchanged. REQUIRED.

firmware.rate_controller_algo: INDI (RATE_CTRL_INDI), firmware/src/control/rate_indi.c — FIRST on-hardware INDI build.
firmware.tune_applied: NONE — compiled rate_indi.h defaults. INDI uses b/k/lpf, not the PID gains (PID struct still holds defaults but is INACTIVE).
firmware.note: k=20 seed was too hot — hunts at ~3.3 Hz (= its own bandwidth). Retuned to k=6/lpf=0.010 AFTER these captures (2026-06-26).

indi._units: b = effectiveness wdot/u [deg/s^2 per unit u] (sysid plant K); k = outer bandwidth [1/s]; lpf_rc = synchronized filter [s].
indi.status: UNFIT placeholders (b yaw is a guess). k=20 caused the broadband hunt.

artifacts.fit_roll.csv: roll u-injection chirp (amp 0.1, 6 s) capture, 620/1000 samples

roll_b_fit.note: CONTAMINATED — INDI was railing/hunting, so captured u was swamped; ~2x below the prior stable-sysid roll K=563. Not trustworthy.

headline: INDI ~3x calmer than PID (pitch RMS 49 vs 144) and no sharp limit cycle, but still a broadband ~3.7 Hz hunt with u railing 56 %. The roll b-fit here is contaminated by that hunt (catch-22: can't fit b while the controller hunts).
